scope: For mass spectrometry analysis of EC proteomes, cells were lysed in 1% sodium deoxycholate (Bioworld), 10 mM TCEP (Thermo Scientific), 40 mM chloroacetamide (Sigma-Aldrich), 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 (Gibco) supplemented with 1× HALT protease/phosphatase inhibitor (Thermo Scientific).
